```sql
WITH order_agg AS (
  SELECT customer_id, order_id, is_drink_order
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."orders"
),
item_agg AS (
  SELECT oi.order_id, oi.product_id, oi.product_price, p.is_drink_item
  FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."order_items" oi
  JOIN "jaffle_shop"."dev"."products" p ON oi.product_id = p.product_id
)
SELECT
  c.customer_id,
  c.customer_name,
  SUM(CASE WHEN ia.is_drink_item THEN ia.product_price ELSE 0 END) AS beverage_revenue,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN oa.is_drink_order THEN oa.order_id END) AS beverage_orders,
  COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ia.is_drink_item THEN ia.product_id END) AS beverage_product_types
FROM "jaffle_shop"."dev"."customers" c
JOIN order_agg oa ON oa.customer_id = c.customer_id
JOIN item_agg ia ON ia.order_id = oa.order_id
GROUP BY c.customer_id, c.customer_name
ORDER BY beverage_revenue DESC
LIMIT 10;
```
